name: graph-engineering-study
personality: mechanical where software can be mechanical
audience_feeling: I can see exactly why the graph called a coding model and exactly what proved the result.
promise: A small study lab that puts deterministic scaffolding and verification around an optional coding worker.

preferred_terms.graph: explicit state and control flow that routes on executable evidence
preferred_terms.coding worker: the replaceable reasoning component called only for hard repair
preferred_terms.validator: deterministic commands whose exit status controls the success edge
preferred_terms.substrate: the known app-builder starter copied before any model edits

avoid: claiming a local run occurred when only GitHub files were changed
good_examples: The compiler decides whether the repair passed; the coding worker only proposes the repair.
bad_examples: The agent reviewed its own work and decided the app is fixed.
